description.text: An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series, released on 28 October 2005 after an early start at Pokémon Centers on 24 October. It introduced δ Delta Species Pokémon, which have a different type from their usual one, along with new Trainers and Special Energy. The story is set at a place called the power spot, deep in the Mirage Forest, and its Star cards are Kyogre, Groudon and Metagross. The cards are numbered to 86. In English it became EX Delta Species in October 2005.
